profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack software engineer with a background in web design and marketing. I have 7 years of total experience in the tech world, with the past 5 years working remote, and 2 of those years focused exclusively on software engineering.

This unique perspective on producing software enables me to create beautiful websites and products that work and solve problems for users.

My day-to-day work is software development using React, Typescript, and .NET Core delivering features for a suite of software products. I also have extensive experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Next.js for building marketing and ecommerce websites.

I'm passionate about learning, exploring new technologies and building cool products! I often create examples, tooling, visualizations, and use writing to better understand concepts and systems. Sharing what I create with others is fulfilling for me!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Drove AI adoption within the company by spearheading the development of a proof of concept applying innovative use of language models to our business model. The concept was built with React, Typescript, and Tailwind CSS, it's backed by an Azure Function App running C# .NET and Open AI API
- Engineered robust software solutions and features for a suite of software products using React, Redux, Typescript, C#, .NET, and SQL including:
 - CRM bulk import systems using EF Core and Azure Service Bus
 - Legacy form migration to React widget with Azure Function service
 - Addition of reporting, notifications and tracking of Message quota usage
- Awarded "Employee of the Quarter" for my exceptional performance, contributions to the team and helpfulness across teams and departments, as voted by peers across the company.
- Collaborated with other engineers, product managers, and QA engineers to design, build, and test web applications using tools such as Slack, Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket

positions.title: Senior Web Designer
positions.description:
- Started department adoption of modern web technologies by leading the development of static site solutions using Next.js and Astro allowing better workflow and efficiency over older Wordpress builds
- Developed, maintained, and optimized dozens of public career website solutions, based on designs from the creative team, using HTML/CSS/JS on a custom .NET platform with Razor pages
- Collaborated with project managers, creative teams, and fellow web designers to implement design specifications into functional websites using. We used tools like Teams, Adobe Creative Cloud, Visual Studio Code
positions.insights: Web Interface Design, JavaScript and +11 skills

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
- Created website design mockups, wireframes & prototypes, hundreds of visual assets, and even branding! All specialized in e-commerce websites
- Worked directly with development and marketing team members to launch and maintain over a dozen e-commerce sites, including BigCommerce, Shopify, and Wordpress websites
- Wrote company marketing articles on web design and e-commerce best practices, directly contributing to the agency's authority and SEO
- Produced email designs, developed emails using HTML and CSS, and managed email drip campaigns

Skills used:
Website Design (Strategy, Wireframe, Design)
Web Development (HTML, CSS, JS, Liquid)
Email Marketing (Design & Development)
positions.insights: Web Interface Design, JavaScript and +6 skills
